A '''qiraadish''' was an [[Foodstuff/Legends|ingredient]] used to make [[interstellar garden salad]]s. One such [[Salad/Legends|salad]] was sold for 5.7 [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits]] at [[Dex's Diner/Legends|Dex's Diner]], an [[Restaurant/Legends|eatery]] operated by the [[Besalisk/Legends|Besalisk]] [[Chef/Legends|chef]] [[Dexter Jettster/Legends|Dexter Jettster]],<ref name="Dining at Dex's" /> on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]]<ref name="Atlas">''[[The Essential Atlas]]''</ref> [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]].<ref name="Dining at Dex's" /> 

==Behind the scenes==
Qiraadishes was mentioned in "[[Dining at Dex's]]," an article written by [[Gregory Walker]] as an [[in-universe]] menu for Dex's Diner that was published on the [[Hyperspace: The Official Star Wars Fan Club|Hyperspace]] section of [[StarWars.com]] on [[December 3]], [[2009]].<ref name="Dining at Dex's" />
